title: hWin face shrunk (GATED): formal/RhAttack/WinCount.lean pins two independent shrinks of the hWin residual's OPEN content - (A) the classical frontier: tPT = 30610046000 (the rigorous zero-isolation record, Platt, interval-verified to +-2^-102, the public stream's own end) with [Z-PT] CITED over the abstract ZeroSet in the Z78 pattern, and faceSplit certifying hWinFace q <-> hWinFaceResidual q (zero-exclusion on (tPT, inf) x (0, 1/200)) - the open face shrinks by a height factor of ~3e7; (B) the 3e9 record shadow: Nline = 9064192826 + rvm3e9 = 9064192825.58 pinned with pinGates (diff = 21/50, |diff| = 0.42 <= 3, norm_num), D_even (Even (B0.D q t) for any ZeroSet), and offExcessBound (pinned on-line count + the record's +-3 strip gate => D(q, 3e9) <= 2 = at most one off-line orbit below 3e9; 0 or 2 with D_even). 99 cards; full tree green (17450 jobs)
body: FORMAL MILESTONE (no RH claim): the open content of the endpoint's hWin residual - characterized in discovery 0105 (S4WinCap: the face IS zero-exclusion on [1000, inf) x (0, 1/200)) - now has two INDEPENDENT shrink routes pinned into the tree.  MODULE:  formal/RhAttack/WinCount.lean (namespace WinC; imports Mathlib + B0 + P12Uniform + S4WinCap; build green; full tree re-verified at 17450 jobs, 0 errors; 0 sorry; 401 lines).  ROUTE A - THE CLASSICAL FRONTIER (cited):  tPT := 30610046000 pins the rigorous zero-isolation record (Platt, 'Isolating some non-trivial zeros of Zeta': rigorous interval-arithmetic isolation of every non-trivial zero with 0 < Im <= 30,610,046,000 to an absolute precision +- 2^-102, an independent verification that the critical line carries them all to that height; the public LMFDB zeta-zero stream - the project's own 24b-series source - ends at exactly this height, so tPT is the RECORD'S OWN frontier, not an external import).  [Z-PT] allOnLineUpTo q tPT is STATED OVER THE ABSTRACT ZeroSet as a named hypothesis (the Z78-strip / Z-EDGE CITED pattern; the higher literature frontier - RH verified up to 3 x 10^12, Platt-Trudgian, arXiv:2004.09765, located by doc-first search this session - is named in the docstring as an optional add-on input; the tree pins the lower, record-consistent frontier).  Both consequences are LEAN-PROVEN and cite nothing beyond [Z-PT]:  (1) noOffPairBelowPT - there is NO off-pair in [1000, tPT] x (0, 1/200) (a zero at negative height is sent to its positive twin by HFE after HCJ before it can hide);  (2) faceSplit - S4WC.hWinFace q <-> hWinFaceResidual q, where hWinFaceResidual (the named residual def) is zero-exclusion on (tPT, inf) x (0, 1/200): under [Z-PT] the hWin face of the endpoint reduces EXACTLY to zero-exclusion above the frontier.  THE SHRINK FACTOR: the open height interval of the face drops from [1000, inf) to (3.06e10, inf) - a factor of about 3e7 in height.  ROUTE B - THE 3e9 RECORD SHADOW (record-derived, the MFar/B7Far measured-constraint pattern):  the H1 3e9 stream record (day035 ceiling report; the finish gate of day035_3e9_stream.sh) is pinned and re-gated:  Nline := 9064192826 (the EXACT on-line zero count up to t = 3e9 in the verified stream, 'N(3e9) = 9,064,192,826 EXACT'), rvm3e9 := 9064192825.58 (the recorded RVM value; RVM counts the STRIP zeros, which is the count that matters);  pinGates (norm_num, arithmetic only): Nline - rvm3e9 = 21/50 exactly and |Nline - rvm3e9| = 0.42 <= 3, i.e. the fleet's own +-3 RVM finish gate, machine-checked in Lean.  Two structural theorems over ANY ZeroSet, LEAN-PROVEN:  D_even - Even (B0.D q t) for all t > 0 (the whole-slice twin of B0.offSliceEven: the fixed-point-free involution rho |-> 1 - rho-bar preserves the height EXACTLY (im(1 - rho-bar) = im rho), so it tiles the entire off-line slice of (0, t] in 2-cycle blocks; proven by the B0 orbit-tile machinery adapted to the whole slice);  offExcessBound - for any q whose on-line count at tdata matches the pinned Nline (the record data fact about the actual set, entered as a hypothesis like S1LowT.SliceFacts) and whose STRIP count passes the record's +-3 gate (|Ntot - rvm3e9| <= n, the same tolerance the fleet ran, stated for the strip count that RVM counts): B0.D q tdata <= n - 1; at the record's tolerance n = 3: D <= 2 - AT MOST ONE OFF-LINE ORBIT below 3e9 (with D_even: the excess is 0 or 2).  The bound spends ONLY B0's structural axioms (nonReal/conj/fe/finite) + the two record pins + the gate - no classical RVM error content is cited, because the argument reads the gate's tolerance n as a parameter: the strip count is Nline + D exactly (B0.eqNtotMinusNon), the RVM pin sits 21/50 below Nline, so the gate forces D + 21/50 <= n.  HONESTY SPLIT:  CITED [Z-PT] (classical, named, reference in the docstring);  PINNED the two record values (norm_num gate);  LEAN-PROVEN noOffPairBelowPT, faceSplit, D_even, offExcessBound.  ENDPOINT RELATION:  RHEnd.rh_program78 is UNAFFECTED; the four named residuals are untouched; hWin is now CHARACTERIZED (0105) AND SHRUNK (0106): its open content is zero-exclusion on (3.06e10, inf) x (0, 1/200) - no instrument in the tree reaches the residual (the classical zero-free regions stop at Re > 1 - c/ln t, nowhere near Re = 1/2 +- 1/200, and the measured zero walk ends at the frontier).  CARDS:  99 cards / 858 body lines (new card formal/cards/WinCount.md); _MAP.md carries the WinCount block in the S4-squeeze section and the hWin line in the endpoint block now reads CHARACTERIZED by S4WinCap + SHRUNK by WinCount; PATHWAY-TO-A-SOLUTION.md carries the GATED paragraph after the S4WinCap FORMAL block.  NEXT LEVER candidates:  (a) an explicit RVM-error input at 3e9 (a doc-first located published bound) would make route B's gate a CITED single hypothesis and shrink route A and B into one;  (b) wiring WinCount's residual def into the endpoint restatement;  (c) the B7F consumer candidates (B1 walk / B5 law territory) from before, or the hs1 height-uniformity measured piece.
